text:
maria (pm): Quick sync — proposing a Q2 "Lite Observability" slice: 1) dashboard template gallery, 2) adaptive trace hooks (per-route slider), 3) cost breakdown by route/model, 4) error-regression alerts. Acme and FinCo pushed this. Need launch criteria + rough eng estimates.

allen (eng): +1. I think dashboards + sampling controls unblock value fastest. Question: per-route sampling bump — implementable as metadata + sampling table?

kevin (sre): From ops POV: global default 1% sampling OK. Per-route bump requires routing/metadata and controllable flags — ~2w infra work. Watch telemetry cardinality.

zoe (design): We can repurpose existing widgets. Proposed templates: "Latency P50/P95/P99", "Cost per-token by model & route", "Error rate & top error traces". I'll mock 3 templates (desktop + mobile) by Wed.

julie (data): For alerts we need a 28-day baseline to detect regressions reliably. Also need these telemetry tags: model_version, route, customer_id (hashed). If customer_id is high-card, we'll need sampling on ingestion.

maria (pm): Draft launch criteria: 1) 3 dashboard templates in gallery, 2) trace hook controls in route settings (default sampler + per-route slider + apply-to-team), 3) per-route cost breakdown exposed in console, 4) regression alert pipeline + 2 pilot customers onboarded.

allen (eng): Rough estimates (cross-team): dashboards: 1w eng + 1w QA; trace hooks infra 2w + frontend 1w; cost breakdown 2w (billing + UI); alerts 1w (data+frontend). Total ~7-8w depending on parallelism.

kevin (sre): Risk note: customer_id tags -> cardinality spike. Recommend hashing customer_id and making per-customer high-card metrics opt-in. Also add retention defaults at 7/30/90 days.

zoe (design): UX detail: route settings slider default to 1% with quick presets (0.1%, 1%, 5%, 10%). Add tooltip: "Sampling affects cost and debug fidelity". Include "apply to all routes for team" checkbox.

maria (pm): Customer asks: Acme wants per-model cost split in the UI. FinCo requires audit logs + HSM key path (this will be Private/Dedicated note). Flagging both for enterprise follow-up.

allen (eng): Action items: 1) I'll write infra design doc (top-level sampling flow + storage + cost impact) by Fri EOD. 2) Zoe to deliver mockups by Wed. 3) Julie to validate baseline queries + sample dataset feasibility by Thu. 4) Kevin to draft runbook & SLO implications.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled infra freeze Fri 00:00–06:00 UTC — plan infra design doc timing accordingly.

maria (pm): If we can parallelize dashboards + mockups we can get a beta with 2 customers in ~6w. Can we commit to that timeline?

allen (eng): Tentatively yes if infra design doc locks by Fri. Will call out dependencies in doc.

kevin (sre): +1 to pilot timeline but must gate on cardinality controls and retention defaults.

zoe (design): ack — will prioritize compact templates for faster dev handoff.

julie (data): I'll surface any blocking data quality issues in the feasibility check by Thu.

maria (pm): Great — will consolidate this into a short RFC and a roadmap slice entry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
